svg.aria-label: Rhea: a local-first cycle tracker with partner sharing. I work on sync and data safety: a durable outbox with compare-and-swap, a hybrid-logical-clock merge and Supabase row-level-security tests. The drawing shows a log leaving the device outbox for Supabase and reaching a read-only partner view.
